claims.claim: Starts interactive, hands-free, dispatch, or monitor sessions and validates when a new session may run headlessly.
Runs monitor sessions in the background with structured strategies and event callbacks.
Runs headless dispatch sessions with completion monitoring and returns immediately with a stable session ID.
Creates observable overlay sessions and returns control with session operations for input, output, status, and termination.
Lets the agent kill, background, configure, send input to, or inspect an active session by ID.
Registers spawn, attach, and dismiss commands for operator-managed coding-agent and background-session workflows.
Dispatch completion can inject a bounded result notification that triggers a new Pi turn.
Launches the command through a local shell-backed PTY with the supplied working directory and a merged process environment.
Processes stream triggers and poll-diff changes without requiring the agent to poll the session.
